|strategy=By [mailto:briank@decipher.com Brian Kallenbach]

[[Imperial Supply]] [[Imperial Supply]] is one of the most potent Force activation cards in the game. In one interrupt, you can activate 4 Force, an amount unequaled by any other Dark Side interrupt, and matched on the Light Side only through [[Spaceport Speeders]]. Granted, you have to lose 2 Force to activate all 4 (Lose one from the text and the interrupt itself), this is hardly a price to pay if it lets you deploy an extra character and battle in the same turn. With the expensive [[Jabba]]'s Palace aliens, Force is more of a hot commodity than ever, and [[Imperial Supply]] has always been a boon to the Star Destroyer deck.

Combos:

[[Imperial Supply]] + Mii'yoom [[M'iiyoom Onith{{!}}Onith]] + [[Monnok]] -- With Yarna da'l Gargan out, your opponent can be relatively safe from your Monnoks. And with a sizable hand, Mii'yoom [[M'iiyoom Onith{{!}}Onith]] becomes near useless. However, [[Imperial Supply]] can paste all of these cards together, giving you extra Force to play around with Mii'yoom, while reducing your opponent's hand to a comfortable size with the Used version of [[Monnok]].
